description: Welcome to your family-friendly apartment 🏡 With three comfortable bedrooms, a modern kitchen and a sunny terrace, this bright space has a warm atmosphere with colourful, stylish touches. Just 4 minutes from Mairie de Saint-Ouen station (L13 and L14), you'll reach Paris and the Eiffel Tower 🌟 in less than 40 minutes. Discover the communal area and the large park nearby. Enjoy children's amenities and a convenient self check-in.The spaceThe accommodation consists of 3 bedrooms: 1 bedroom with 1 double bed (160x200cm), 1 bedroom with 1 double bed (140x190cm) and 1 bedroom with 2 single beds (190x90). A living room with an open-plan kitchen, and we have an overhead projector.We are a Franco-Spanish family with two children. Our apartment is decorated in a warm and colourful style. This unique blend of cultures adds a special charm to our apartment, creating a welcoming and authentic atmosphere.Other things to noteApartment located right at the foot of La Communale, a gourmet, cultural and festive venue in Saint-Ouen.Located in the heart of the Docks district, La Communale is much more than just a gourmet market hall. It is a 12,000-square-metre multipurpose space that combines food, culture and festivities. Here's what you can expect from this unique place:- Gourmet Catering: A dozen food kiosks open their arms to you, offering a tempting variety of choices. From Taiwanese street food to burgers, pizzas, Moroccan specialities and even pâté en croûte, there's something for everyone.- Cultural atmosphere: La Communale is home to a 300-seat theatre, where you can attend artistic and cultural events. Whether it's a concert, a play or an exhibition, art takes centre stage.- Workspaces: Need a quiet place to work? La Communale also offers co-working spaces where you can combine
